title: Passé composé with avoir and être; agreement

questions.prompt: Complete: « Hier, j'___ un documentaire. »
questions.explanation: Regarder forms the passé composé with avoir: j'ai regardé.

questions.prompt: Complete: « Elle ___ au théâtre samedi. »
questions.explanation: Aller takes être and the feminine singular participle allée.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct masculine plural agreement: « Les garçons sont ___. »
questions.explanation: With être, the participle agrees in masculine plural: partis.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct feminine plural agreement: « Elles sont ___ tôt. »
questions.explanation: With être, arrivées agrees with the feminine plural subject.

questions.prompt: Choose the passé composé of prendre with nous.
questions.explanation: Prendre takes avoir and its past participle is pris.

questions.prompt: Complete the negative: « Elle ___ pas fini ses devoirs. »
questions.explanation: Ne becomes n' before a vowel and surrounds the auxiliary with pas.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct compound past of se lever for a girl.
questions.explanation: The reflexive verb uses s'est and the participle agrees here: levée.

questions.prompt: Complete: « Vous ___ vu ce film ? »
questions.explanation: Voir takes avoir and vous uses avez as the auxiliary.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct passé composé of écrire for je.
questions.explanation: Écrire uses avoir and its past participle is écrit.

questions.prompt: Read « Luc a pris le train, puis il est arrivé à Dijon. » Which auxiliary appears with arriver?
questions.explanation: Est is a form of être in il est arrivé.

questions.prompt: Read « Elles sont sorties à midi. » What does the ending -es indicate here?
questions.explanation: Sorties agrees with feminine plural elles.

questions.prompt: Read « Nous avons acheté des billets. » What did they purchase?
questions.explanation: Acheter des billets means to buy tickets.

questions.prompt: Read « Maxime n'a pas oublié son sac. » What does the negative mean?
choices: Maxime did not forget the bag.
questions.explanation: Ne ... pas negates the completed event of forgetting.

questions.prompt: Read « Elle est rentrée avant huit heures. » When did she return?
questions.explanation: Avant huit heures means before eight o'clock.

questions.prompt: Read « Nous nous sommes rencontrés en juin. » What event is expressed?
questions.explanation: Nous nous sommes rencontrés expresses a completed meeting.

questions.prompt: Read « J'ai déjà lu cette histoire. » What does déjà contribute?
choices: The action is occurring for the first time now.
questions.explanation: Déjà indicates that reading happened already.

questions.prompt: Read « Les filles sont descendues du bus. » What grammatical feature is visible?
choices: The feminine plural participle descended with être.
questions.explanation: Descendues is feminine plural, agreeing with les filles.

questions.prompt: Read « Il a eu peur, mais il a continué. » Which auxiliary is used twice?
questions.explanation: Both a eu and a continué use forms of avoir as auxiliary.

questions.prompt: You describe a woman who left yesterday. Choose the correct sentence.
questions.explanation: Partir uses être, with feminine singular agreement partie.

questions.prompt: You describe two boys who visited a museum. Which is correct?
questions.explanation: Visiter takes avoir; its participle does not agree with its preceding subject.

questions.prompt: You need to say you did not understand. Choose the correct sentence.
questions.explanation: Comprendre uses avoir and the negative brackets the auxiliary.

questions.prompt: A student writes « Elles sont arrivé ». Which correction is appropriate?
questions.explanation: Arrivées agrees with the feminine plural subject elles.

questions.prompt: You need to ask a friend whether they have finished. Which is correct?
questions.explanation: Terminer normally takes avoir and the past participle terminé.

questions.prompt: Two girls say they got up early. Choose the accurate sentence.
questions.explanation: The reflexive construction uses être with feminine plural agreement.

questions.prompt: A student writes « J'ai prendu le bus ». Choose the correct revision.
questions.explanation: The irregular past participle of prendre is pris.

questions.prompt: You are describing a girl and a boy who arrived. Choose the conventional agreement.
questions.explanation: Mixed-gender plural subjects conventionally take masculine plural agreement.

questions.prompt: You want to combine two completed events in order. Which sentence is grammatical?
choices: J'ai préparer mon sac, puis je suis sortis.
J'ai préparé mon sac, puis je suis sorti.
Je suis préparé mon sac, puis j'ai sorti.
questions.explanation: Préparer uses avoir, and sortir in intransitive movement use can take être.
